title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
description: Anthropic launched reporting tools that show enterprise customers what their token spending is producing. The company says it will not use this usage data for model training by default.

title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
description: Microsoft reported about $10 billion in revenue tied to its OpenAI arrangements in the quarter ended September 30. That is nearly 11% of its $92.3 billion total quarterly revenue.

title: Anthropic IPO filing warns some risks may be uninsurable. AI coverage will be issue for every company
description: Anthropic's S-1 warns that some AI-related risks may be difficult or impossible to insure, noting the insurance market for AI-specific risks is nascent. CNBC argues AI coverage will become an issue for every company deploying the technology.

title: Nasdaq-100 futures dip as Alphabet shares sell off after earnings report: Live updates
description: Alphabet reported Google Cloud revenue doubling to $31 billion, while capital expenditures hit a record $51.4 billion and free cash flow turned negative at $9.1 billion. Shares sold off after the report.
